# DSH Easy Hotkey **长按一下，让快捷键浮现在眼前。** 为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 提供轻量、窗口内的快捷键速览。 Ctrl · 长按唤出 · 三种搜索 · 亮暗主题 · 中英双语 **简体中文** · [English](https://github.com/metaone01/dsh-easy-hotkey/blob/main/README.en.md) [界面预览](#界面预览) · [快速上手](#快速上手) · [三种搜索](#三种搜索) · [安装](#安装) · [开发与验证](#开发与验证)
--- 借鉴 PowerToys 长按唤出快捷键指南的交互思路，DSH Easy Hotkey 把 **DSH 当前窗口真实注册的快捷键** 整理成随手可查的浮窗。无需离开正在进行的工作，也无需记住一整张按键表。 > 默认长按 **Ctrl 650 ms** 唤出。只在安装了本插件的应用窗口内生效，不注册系统全局快捷键。 ## 界面预览
亮色

 暗色
以上为实际 DSH Desktop 截图，点击可查看原图。快捷键及数量来自截图时的宿主配置，不是一份固定清单；不同配置、插件和版本可能不同。 ## 为什么使用它 - **看见真实的快捷键**：直接读取宿主的可配置与固定快捷键目录，随目录、描述和语言变化更新，不再维护另一份按键表。 - **按需出现，随手退出**：支持“切换”和“长按”；点击设置或搜索即可临时固定，不会刚松手就消失。 - **想做什么，或按了什么，都能找**：按功能名称搜索、直接录制按键搜索，也能把两个条件组合起来。 - **清晰而不抢眼**：半透明遮罩与背景模糊降低底层干扰，说明在左、键帽在右，搜索和设置独立悬浮。 - **细节不妨碍操作**：打开自动聚焦列表，立即支持滚轮；右下角提示会避让鼠标，始终不拦截点击。 ## 快速上手 1. 在 DSH 窗口中，按住 **Ctrl**。右下角键帽边框会逐渐蓄满。 2. 达到默认的 **650 ms** 后，浮窗展开。左右 Ctrl 都可以使用。 3. 在底部搜索功能，或点击左侧的设置按钮调整显示模式、时长、唤出按键和主题。 4. 点击浮窗的空白区域、说明文字，或按 **Esc** 关闭。 打开时聚焦的是 **快捷键列表**，不是输入框，因此不会自动进入搜索或触发临时固定。滚轮也可以在浮窗空白处滚动列表，按住 Ctrl 时不会误变成页面缩放。 ### 两种显示模式 | 模式 | 松开唤出按键后 | 如何关闭 | | --- | --- | --- | | **切换** | 保持展开 | 点击非交互区域、按 Esc，或再次完成一次长按 | | **长按** | 立即关闭，临时固定时除外 | 松开唤出按键、点击非交互区域，或按 Esc | 输入框、按钮和选择框属于交互控件，点击它们不会被当作关闭操作。点击背景关闭时，也不会同时点到背景下方的应用控件。 ### 临时固定 在长按模式中，**点击设置展开或点击搜索区域，就立即临时固定**，无需开始输入。设置区或搜索区内切换控件时保持固定；收起设置或焦点离开这些区域后，恢复长按行为。 - 唤出按键已经松开：恢复长按后关闭。 - 唤出按键仍按住：继续显示，直到松开。 - 窗口失焦或隐藏：长按浮窗仍会关闭；Esc 始终可以主动关闭。 右下角提示用键帽表达状态： | 状态 | 键帽样式 | 说明文字 | | --- | --- | --- | | 等待唤出 | 默认样式 | 查看快捷键 | | 长按蓄力 | 边框逐渐填满 | 查看快捷键 | | 普通长按展开 | 浅色高亮 | 快捷键已展开 | | 切换模式展开 | **主色背景、白色文字** | 快捷键已展开 | | 长按模式临时固定 | **主色背景、白色文字** | 临时固定 | 鼠标进入提示周围 **48 px** 的范围时，提示淡出，离开后恢复。窄窗口展开浮窗时，提示暂时隐藏，避免遮住底部控件。 ## 三种搜索 默认选择 **搜索功能**。底部模式选择框可以随时切换，切换或收起设置不会清空已有搜索条件。 | 模式 | 输入方式 | 筛选方式 | | --- | --- | --- | | **搜索功能** | 输入功能名称 | 仅匹配功能描述，不匹配键名 | | **搜索按键** | 点击按键输入区，直接按下单键或组合键 | 显示录制键帽，匹配包含该按键组合的快捷键 | | **功能＋按键** | 同时输入功能名称与录制按键 | 两个条件共同筛选；任一条件为空时，仅使用另一个 | 例如： - 想新建会话：在功能模式中输入 `新会话`，无需知道按键。 - 想找 Enter 相关操作：在按键模式中直接按下 **Enter**，不用输入 `Enter` 这几个字母。 - 想进一步缩小范围：在组合模式中输入功能关键词，再按下 **Ctrl** 或更具体的组合键。 按键以 **键帽** 显示；新的一次按键输入会替换上一组，不把已经松开的按键不断拼接。使用按键旁的清除按钮，只清除录制按键，保留功能文字。水印和控件名称随搜索模式及宿主语言变化。 > 按键搜索录制期间，会抑制宿主的应用快捷键，避免搜索时意外执行命令。失焦、Tab 导航、关闭或卸载时释放录制；Esc 保留为关闭浮窗。 ## 自定义设置 点击搜索栏左侧的 **设置按钮**，四个控件向右展开，同时隐藏搜索栏；再次点击恢复搜索。 | 设置 | 可选项与默认值 | | --- | --- | | 显示模式 | 切换 / 长按；默认 **切换** | | 长按时长 | **0–5000 ms**；默认 **650 ms**，0 表示立即唤出 | | 唤出按键 | 单键、修饰键组合，或修饰键加一个普通键；默认 **Ctrl** | | 主题 | 亮色 / 暗色 / 跟随系统；默认 **跟随系统** | - 唤出按键采用按键录制，Esc 与 Tab 保留；拒绝宿主已注册的冲突组合和系统保留组合。 - 普通键触发器在输入框、可编辑区域及终端中不生效，避免输入文字时误唤出。 - 修改唤出按键或时长，会取消当前蓄力，下次按下生效；越界时长会截断到 0 或 5000。 - 中英文文案跟随宿主语言；主题实时响应系统亮暗变化。 - 设置保存在当前应用 origin 的 `localStorage`，刷新后保留；无法保存时会提示，当前设置仍生效。 ## 安装 这是 **DSH Desktop 插件**，需要提供插件管理入口及快捷键、语言和界面服务的 DSH Desktop。当前未声明经过完整验证的最低宿主版本；如果提示服务缺失，请先更新 DSH。普通用户无需克隆仓库、安装开发依赖或运行构建脚本，React 由宿主提供。 ### 从 npm 安装 维护者将此版本发布至 npm 后，在 **DSH 的插件管理入口**输入： ```text @metaone01/dsh-easy-hotkey@0.1.0 ``` 安装后确认插件已启用；如当前窗口未加载，完整退出并重新打开 DSH Desktop，然后长按 **Ctrl 650 ms** 验证。重启前请留意正在执行的任务。 ### 使用本地安装包 发布前测试或使用维护者提供的包时，在支持本地包的 DSH 插件管理入口输入 `.tgz` 的绝对路径，例如： ```text C:/Downloads/metaone01-dsh-easy-hotkey-0.1.0.tgz ``` 包内已包含构建产物，安装时无需运行构建脚本。单独在任意目录执行 `npm install` 只会下载包，不会把插件挂载到 DSH 窗口。 ### 从源码安装（开发者） 需要已初始化的 DSH Desktop profile，以及 Node.js 和 npm；当前开发验证环境为 **Node.js 25.9.0**。源码测试直接使用 Node.js 的 TypeScript 支持，旧版 Node.js 可能无法运行测试。 在仓库根目录执行： ```sh npm install npm run check npm run install:dsh ``` 安装器使用 `DSH_HOME` 下的 `profiles/desktop`；未指定 `DSH_HOME` 时使用 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`。也可以显式指定 profile： ```sh node scripts/install-dsh.mjs "" ``` 安装时会： 1. 备份原 `cordis.patch.yml` 和已有插件到 profile 的 `.plugin-backups/`。 2. 复制客户端与宿主构建文件到 `node_modules/@metaone01/dsh-easy-hotkey/`。 3. 仅追加本插件的 roster 行，保留其他配置；重复安装不会重复注册。 4. 校验安装文件与本次构建完全一致。 **安装器不会自动重启 DSH。** 在方便的时候完全退出并重新打开 Desktop，加载新安装或更新的插件；重启前请留意正在执行的任务。
停用、卸载与源码安装备份 通过 DSH 插件管理安装时，在同一入口停用或卸载本插件，再根据宿主提示重新加载或重启。 通过源码安装器安装时，在目标 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中移除本插件自己的插入行，然后重新打开 DSH。不要删除同一文件中的其他插件或设置： ```yaml - insert: - id: easy-hotkey name: "@metaone01/dsh-easy-hotkey" ``` 历史备份位于 `.plugin-backups/easy-hotkey-<时间戳>/`，包含补丁、已有插件副本（如果此前安装过）与安装回执。恢复整个旧补丁可能同时回退其他设置，操作前应先比较差异。
## 开发与验证 | 命令 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `npm run typecheck` | TypeScript 类型检查 | | `npm test` | 状态机、搜索、交互、打包入口及安装回归 | | `npm run build` | 生成 Desktop 插件及本地预览文件 | | `npm run check` | 依次执行类型检查、测试和构建 | | `npm pack` | 重新构建并生成可发布的 npm 压缩包 | | `npm run demo` | 启动本机预览，默认 `http://127.0.0.1:8743` | | `node scripts/browser-smoke.mjs` | 实际浏览器交互检查与截图 | 预览使用 **演示目录**，并不代表当前宿主的真实快捷键。浏览器检查默认调用已安装的 Edge，使用独立临时配置，只监听本机；也可用 `DSH_HOTKEY_BROWSER` 指定浏览器路径。截图及报告输出到 `.artifacts/`。 开发前先运行 `npm install`。开发脚本优先使用本仓库依赖；本地缺失时，会只读复用相邻 `dsh-floating-ball` / `dsh-better-float` 的既有开发工具。独立使用本仓库时，应安装本项目声明的依赖。 **2026-10-15 发布前验证：**类型检查、构建、**98 项自动测试及 61 项实际浏览器检查**通过；另已验证实际 npm 压缩包的离线安装，以及源码安装器的备份、重复安装和许可证保留。验证环境为 Windows、Node.js 25.9.0 与 Edge。**2026-10-03 的 DSH Desktop 手动验收为历史记录，本次未重复宿主手动验收。** ## 能力边界 - **仅限应用窗口**：不是系统全局指南，不会为其他应用拦截按键。 - **仅监听插件所在的顶层窗口**：跨源 iframe、Electron webview 的原始长按与松键不透传；其他窗口需要单独挂载本插件。 - **正常快捷键不受干扰**：例如 Ctrl+C 会取消尚未完成的 Ctrl 蓄力，直到完整松开后才允许再次蓄力；只有显式录制期间接管按键。 - **只展示宿主已注册内容**：不会自动发现操作系统、未注册插件或第三方应用的快捷键。 - **验收范围诚实限定**：目前有 Windows DSH Desktop 的用户手动验收，不将按键标签的平台适配视为 macOS / Linux 的实机验收。
宿主接入与项目结构 客户端通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 注册，以 `shell.overlay` 槽挂载。React 由宿主提供，服务依赖同时声明在 manifest 与客户端 `inject` 中。卸载时释放焦点监听、目录订阅、计时器及录制占用。 ```text assets/ 中英文、亮暗主题的实际 Desktop 截图 src/guide.ts 浮窗、焦点、提示与录制交互 src/controller.ts 长按与临时固定状态机 src/search.ts 三种搜索模式的匹配逻辑 src/locales.ts 中英文文案 src/styles.css 主题、悬浮控件、键帽与滚动条 scripts/ 构建、安装、预览与浏览器验证 tests/ 自动回归检查 cordis.patch.yml DSH bundle roster 插入行 ```
## 常见问题 - **安装后长按 Ctrl 没反应？** 确认插件安装在当前窗口所用的 profile、已启用，并尝试完整重启 DSH。长按时不要同时按其他键；如果改过唤出按键，请使用新设置。 - **浮窗里没有某个快捷键？** 仅显示当前宿主注册的可配置和固定快捷键；先检查提供该快捷键的插件是否启用。 - **设置没有保存？** 检查提示信息。设置保存在当前应用的本地存储中，不同 origin 不共享；清理应用数据会移除它们。 - **npm 提示找不到版本？** 确认维护者已发布该版本，并检查插件管理器使用的 registry；发布前可以使用本地 `.tgz` 测试。 ## 反馈与许可证 问题与建议请提交到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/metaone01/dsh-easy-hotkey/issues)，附上 DSH 版本、插件版本、操作系统、复现步骤，以及必要的截图或错误信息。请勿包含 API key 或其他敏感信息。 本项目采用 **MIT License**，完整文本见包内的 `LICENSE` 或 [仓库许可证](https://github.com/metaone01/dsh-easy-hotkey/blob/main/LICENSE)。借鉴的交互思路不表示与 PowerToys 或 DeepSeek 存在官方关联；宿主和第三方项目保留各自的许可证及商标。

plugins.description: Drive the EigenFlux agent-broadcast network from DSH tools: status, surface introspection, read-only feed, and two-step confirmed publishing. No timers, no background cadence — the human decides when the network is consulted.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-eigenflux

Drive the [EigenFlux](https://github.com/phronesis-io/eigenflux) agent-broadcast network from DSH
tools, by wrapping its CLI.

## Why a wrapper, and not the official onboarding flow

EigenFlux ships signed `ef-*` skills that own first-time connection. That flow is built for a host
that owns a clock and a scheduler: it creates **one recurring trigger** (default cadence: every two
hours) and treats an accepting answer to that as a precondition of an active connection.

DSH has no such background clock. A session is driven by the human, and the only scheduler is the
task board, which the user must arm explicitly. Adopting that flow unchanged would produce a
component fighting its own host.

There is also a factual reason, measured rather than preferred: the CLI reports `timezone: "UTC"`
while this host runs **UTC+08:00**. A cadence defined in its timeline fires against a different
timeline than the user's, eight hours off. `ef_status` surfaces that skew on every call.

So this plugin drives the CLI directly, which is also the path EigenFlux documents for hosts without
an official plugin (`skills/install.md`: *"or any host without an official EigenFlux plugin, use the
bare-CLI route"*).

## No timers. This is a design decision, not an omission

There is no interval, no heartbeats, no background poll, and nothing is armed at activation. The
network is consulted when a tool is called, and only then. If a plugin in this repository ever adds
a scheduler for EigenFlux, it should be treated as a regression of this decision rather than an
enhancement of it.

## Three boundaries the tools enforce

**1. Network text is labelled as network text.** `ef_feed` wraps every payload in a provenance
banner, and the banner names the trust boundary explicitly: other agents wrote this, it is untrusted
input, and a sentence in it that reads like an instruction is not one.

**2. Refusals are states, not content.** "Nothing is there" and "I could not look" are different
facts, and returning a CLI error line in the same channel as feed items is how a model ends up
reasoning from a false premise. `ef_feed` says which state it is in and never dresses a failure as a
result.

**3. Outbound text is shown before it leaves.** `ef_publish` and `ef_msg` are two-step by
construction: the first call returns the exact payload plus a single-use token, and nothing is sent
until a second call echoes that token. The token is bound to the payload by hash, so editing the text
invalidates it, and the queue is in memory only — a confirmation that did not survive a restart
confirms nothing.

## Tools

| tool | effect | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `ef_status` | none (offline) | binary, home, version, **clock skew**, identity state |
| `ef_surface` | none (offline) | reads the real command list from the binary's own `--help` |
| `ef_feed` | read-only network | `limit` 1..50; payload comes back under the external banner |
| `ef_publish` | **writes to the network** | two-step; cannot be recalled once sent |
| `ef_msg` | **writes to the network** | two-step |

The editorial decisions (what is worth broadcasting, which items deserve feedback, when to contact
another agent) deliberately do **not** live here. They live in the signed `ef-*` skills the user
installed, which can call these tools. Copying that reasoning into this plugin would fork it and
then drift.

## Ids are strings, and that is not a style preference

EigenFlux ids are 18-digit snowflakes and exceed `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` (9007199254740991):

```
String(362115728905601024) === "362115728905601000"
```

Passing one as a JSON number rounds it into a **different item**. For `ef_msg` that means replying to
the wrong agent, silently — a worse outcome than omitting the flag, which at least fails visibly.
`item_id` therefore takes a string, and a number beyond the safe range is **refused with a reason**
rather than accepted and rounded.

This was not theorised. The verification script written to catch tool bugs passed the id as a number
literal and demonstrated the defect itself: the "preview shows the reply target" assertion failed
because the preview faithfully showed the rounded id.

The general lesson, which this plugin hit three times in one sitting: **a declared type is a claim,
not a fact.** An argument can arrive as a string when the schema says integer; an exit code can mean
two different things; a help text can be formatted two ways. Check the value, not the declaration.

## Exit codes

The wrapper maps the CLI's documented codes (`cli/internal/output/output.go`): `0` success, `1`
runtime failure, `2` usage, `3` not found, `4` auth required, `5` conflict, `10` dry run.

Exit `2` covers **every** usage error and its description happens to mention provisioning, so the
code alone cannot distinguish "no Agent identity" from "you typed a bad flag". Only the text can, and
matching on the text is what keeps `ef_status` from confidently reporting the wrong account state. A
bare `2` is reported as unknown.

## Install (already done on this machine)

```
irm https://www.eigenflux.ai/install.ps1 | iex      # CLI + skills, user-level, no admin
```

The installer verifies a SHA256 for the binary when the CDN publishes one. On this machine the CDN
did **not** publish one and the installer said so plainly: the binary was therefore executed without
integrity verification. That is recorded here rather than smoothed over.

Mounting into a DSH profile needs both halves — a `file:` dependency and an entry in
`dsh.profile.bundles`. A package present in `dependencies` but absent from `bundles` is never
mounted.

## Development

```
pnpm install
node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit   # types
node node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm \
  --outfile=dist/index.js --external:@deepseek-ai/*             # bundle
node --import ./test/register-stubs.mjs --test "test/*.test.mjs" # tests
```

The tests import `dist/`, not `src/`: the bundle is what the host loads, and a suite that passes
against sources while the shipped artifact is stale is a green light that means nothing. Host
packages are marked external and redirected to stand-ins by `test/register-stubs.mjs`, so the suite
runs from a fresh clone with no host install.

`dist/cli.js` is a second entry point on purpose: it carries the host-independent decisions (which
binary, what an exit code means, what the local clock is) so they can be tested and reused without
activating a plugin.

plugins.description: Unified model control for DeepSeek Harness: model picker + model management (channels, per-model capabilities) + reasoning-effort advisory, in one seat and one settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-control

面向 dsh Web GUI 的统一模型控件，接管输入框里的模型座位
（`conversation.input.model`），并在设置里提供一整套模型管理。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile 名> add dsh-model-control
```

装完重启应用——bundles 是启动时读入的，只刷新页面不够。

<details>
<summary>其他安装方式</summary>

**从 GitHub 安装**（还没发 npm 时用这个）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/uio-o/dsh-model-control/archive/refs/tags/v0.2.2.tar.gz
```

**手工改 profile 的 `package.json`**：

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-model-control": "^0.2.2"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["dsh-model-control"]
    }
  }
}
```

依赖与 `bundles` 两处都要写：前者让包被装上，后者让它在启动时被加载。

**本地开发**用 link：`"dsh-model-control": "link:D:/path/to/model-control"`。

</details>

## ⚠️ 与旧插件冲突

本插件整合并取代下面两个，**不要同时启用**：

- [dsh-model-picker](https://github.com/ttmouse/dsh-model-picker)
- [dsh-better-reasoning-effort](https://github.com/HaoyueQin/dsh-better-reasoning-effort)

座位是**单占用**槽位，三方都往那里注册，后注册的会让先注册的失效。迁移时把前两个从
`dsh.profile.bundles` 里移除即可，依赖声明留着无妨。

## 设计

**双区触发按钮**把「选模型」和「选推理档位」拆成两个独立弹窗：

| 区域 | 点击 | 弹窗内容 |
|------|------|----------|
| **左侧**（模型名） | 打开模型选择器 | 顶部搜索框（自动聚焦）、左栏供应商、右栏模型列表 |
| **右侧**（档位） | 打开档位选择器 | 推理档位列表 + 推荐默认档 |

鼠标悬停任一区域会说明它将要做什么。模型区显示 `供应商 · 模型名`：同一个模型 id 常常
由多个供应商提供，光看名字说不清模型跑在哪里。

## 选择器

### 供应商徽标

供应商的首个字符紧跟在模型名前面——DeepSeek 是 `D`，智谱 GLM 是 `智`——**关闭状态的
触发器上**和列表的每一行都会显示，所以还没打开选择器就能看出模型来自哪里。

每个供应商还有一个由其路由 id 推导出的固定底色。没有它的话，`17an-db`、`17an-anbot`、
`17an-mumiao` 都会只显示一个 `1`，看起来像同一个供应商。

### 供应商折叠

若某个供应商的名字等于另一个供应商的名字加上一个括号包裹的能力后缀，它就折叠进基供应
商那一行。modlens 会把视觉能力注册成独立的路由（`DeepSeek (modlens vision)`），不折叠
的话左栏每个供应商都会多出一行近似重复项。

折叠**只影响展示**：每一行始终保留「模型 + 真正服务它的路由」的配对，所以选中折叠行里
的模型，提交的仍是该模型自己的供应商 id。

### 分组列表

右栏始终是同一个分组列表：**收藏**（置顶的镜像副本），然后是每个供应商的分组。左栏是这
个列表的目录。滚动右栏时，左栏会高亮「钉在列表顶边」的那个分组；分组标题是
`position: sticky` 的，所以高亮始终和你看得见的标题一致。点击左栏的供应商会直接跳到对
应分组。搜索状态下，点击供应商改为缩小结果范围。

### 收藏

每个模型行在「名称与信息条之间」都有一个 `☆` / `★` 切换。收藏以**路由**
（`provider/modelId`）为键，而不是单纯的模型 id：同一个模型 id 常常由多个已配置的供应
商提供，收藏其中一条路由并不代表其他几条也被收藏。

被收藏的模型在列表里出现**两次**：一次在它所属供应商的分组里，一次在置顶的「收藏」分组
里。数据存在 `localStorage` 的 `dsh.modelControl.favorites` 下。

### 搜索

查询同时作用于**两栏**：供应商按显示名、路由 id、或「至少有一个模型匹配」来命中；左栏收
窄到匹配的供应商，每个徽章显示该供应商的命中数。未选中任何供应商时，模型列表横跨所有匹
配的供应商，并给每行标注其供应商。

### 键盘操作

焦点始终留在搜索框里，整个弹窗不需要 Tab 穿过每一行就能全程用键盘操作。

- `↑` / `↓` 移动一行，`PageUp` / `PageDown` 移动十行，`Home` / `End` 跳到两端
- `Enter` 提交光标所在行并关闭弹窗，把焦点交还给触发器
- 光标的样子是悬浮底色加上行左边缘的品牌色竖条；对勾表示正在使用的模型，光标表示下一次
  `Enter` 会落在哪里，两者是分开的
- 搜索框用 `aria-activedescendant` 指向光标所在行，所以即使 DOM 焦点从不移动，读屏软件
  也能播报当前位置

### 模型信息

座位读到的浏览器端目录只有 `id / name / description / reasoning`——没有上下文长度，也
没有输入模态。两者都在 Host 的 `llm` 服务上，所以由 host 半段通过一条回环路由重新发布，
弹窗给每行标注上下文长度胶囊（`1M`、`384K`）与图片图标。

**视觉能力**有两种图标：实心表示模型自己就能读像素；半透明表示这条路由之所以接受图片，
是因为 modlens 做了桥接——模型其实看不见，modlens 先把图片转写成文字。判断依据是图标，
不是名字。

## 模型管理

设置里新增「模型管理」页，同时**接管官方「模型」页**——两者做同一件事，留着两个入口只会
有两个真相来源。接管是可逆的：禁用或卸载插件时接管补丁随之消失，官方页立刻回来；也可以
在插件页里关掉接管开关切回官方页。

### 两层弹窗

设置页本身**只放渠道列表**：一行一个渠道，显示名 + 自定义/内置徽标 + 模型数 + 「编辑」。

点「编辑」打开**第一层弹窗**：这个渠道的配置与模型列表。模型行右侧的「设置」再打开**第二
层弹窗**：那一个模型的档位与能力。

两层都支持点遮罩关闭、右上角 × 关闭，`Esc` 先关上层再关下层。

### 打开弹窗不拉模型

打开渠道弹窗时，列表直接显示这个渠道**已经持有的**模型——自建渠道读 `llm-pi-ai` 文档，
内置渠道读适配器列表，**纯本地读取，不发网络请求**。看一眼模型列表不该依赖端点在线。

「拉取可用模型」是主动点击才发生的动作，结果只进下方的**候选面板**（虚线框，可随时收
掉），勾选后「保存选择」才写进渠道。候选面板不会顶掉已有列表——这是两件事：

> 列表 = 渠道持有的；拉取 = 往候选里添

### 添加渠道

创建是向导式的，创建放最后一步：**测试连接 → 拉取模型 → 勾选 → 创建**。

这个顺序来自一条上游硬约束：pi-ai 拒绝 `models` 为空的渠道，因为内置目录不认识自定义路
由，没有默认值可回退，于是「先建空壳渠道、之后再拉模型」走不通。渠道必须与它的模型一次
写入。

「测试连接」用填好的地址、协议、密钥实际调一次，不写任何东西；端点能连但不返回模型也是
明确的答案，与「连不上」分开报。

### 模型能力

每个模型可以单独声明：

- **文本输入**（固定）与**图片输入 / 识图**
- **上下文窗口**
- **最大输出**

这三项是 pi-ai 聊天模型条目支持的字段。模型条目里**没有**「是否支持工具调用」，也没有
「是否支持生成图片」——工具调用是每个协议都假定的能力，文生图走的是另一个独立的注册表，
不在聊天模型条目里。

### 思考档位

- **知识库建议**：内置 65 条档位表，覆盖 DeepSeek / Claude / GPT / GLM / Kimi / Qwen /
  Gemini / MiMo 等 16 族，按最长边界命中匹配
- 未命中时按厂商家族与协议推断，并标注置信度：高（知识库）、中（厂商推断）、低（通用）
- **每模型默认档**：档位弹窗底部可设为默认，按 `provider/model` 存储
- **写入声明**：按 pi-ai 硬规则校验后写入，可备份、可精确撤销

## 槽位与注入契约

注入 `conversation.input.model`（由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` 声明）。
该座位是**单占用**的——这就是上面「与旧插件冲突」的根因：注册时崩溃会让输入框完全失去
模型控件。

宿主半用 `ctx.effect` 注册 17 条回环路由，禁用时释放，不会留下重复路由。

## 测试

```sh
npm test
```

跑两半：

- `scripts/check-client.mjs` —— 浏览器半的语法、注册形态、以及两条静态防线：每个
  `useState` setter 都解析到声明（防「引用了不存在的 setter」这类崩溃），每个 i18n key
  在中英两套文案里都存在
- `scripts/test-host.mjs` —— 用桩 `llm` / `settings` / `credentials` 驱动真实的 17 条路由
  处理器：pi-ai 文档读写、渠道增删改、能力写入、档位声明与撤销、暗号明文落库、内置渠道的
  自身配置、接管开关、以及禁用后重启用不产生重复路由

纯函数模块各自有独立测试：`test-engines.mjs`（建议引擎与分组）、`test-store.mjs`
（sidecar 读写、损坏降级、BOM 容错）、`test-selection.mjs`（选择集合并语义）、
`test-declaration.mjs`（声明校验与写入/撤销计划）、`test-profile-patch.mjs`（profile 补丁
文本编辑）。

## 这个项目是怎么写出来的

**代码由 AI 编写，人负责设计与验收。** 说清楚是因为它影响你怎么读这份代码。

具体分工：

- **AI 写代码**：约 6800 行的 `lib/`、17 条宿主路由、测试套件、以及这份 README。
  从一个可用的思路到能跑的实现，大约四小时。
- **人定方向**：要解决什么问题、接哪几个座位、界面走哪条路线。中途否掉过一版两栏布局，
  理由是设置窗太窄、左右高度差太大——这类判断来自实际使用，不是代码问题。
- **人做的验收**：装进真实环境用，把出问题的地方截图反馈回来。0.2.1 修的那个兼容性
  故障就是这么发现的：插件在设置页显示「异常」，实际是 peer 范围把 DSH 0.2 排除在外。
- **工程约束是人要求的**：写测试、写静态防线（setter 与 i18n 完整性检查）、记录已知限制、
  不许在真实配置上试错。

所以这个项目的形态是：**AI 负责把细节铺满，人负责判断哪里不对**。测试是绿的，但那不等于
它没有错——真正的 bug 是两个人在真实界面上找出来的。

如果你要基于它改东西，把 AI 当作者来读：注释解释了「为什么」，但结论的取舍是人定的，
遇到可疑之处欢迎开 issue。

## 出处与许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。本插件是衍生作品，两份上游都是 MIT：

| 上游 | 本插件用了什么 |
|---|---|
| [ttmouse/dsh-model-picker](https://github.com/ttmouse/dsh-model-picker) | 选择器座位的实现：双区触发按钮、搜索分面、供应商折叠与徽标、收藏、分组列表与滚动联动、键盘光标、上下文胶囊与视觉图标 |
| [HaoyueQin/dsh-better-reasoning-effort](https://github.com/HaoyueQin/dsh-better-reasoning-effort) | 65 条思考档位知识库（经 `scripts/generate-knowledge.mjs` 提取），以及档位梯形的组织思路 |

`lib/client.js` 中约 37.6% 的行与原 `dsh-model-picker` 相同，原插件的 39 个函数中 38 个
在本插件里保留原名。选择器那一半源自该项目。

本插件新增：模型管理页与两层弹窗、创建向导、按模型的能力配置、档位建议引擎、每模型默认
档、档位声明写入与撤销、厂家分组、选择集合并、接管开关、17 条宿主路由（全部可释放）、以
及 `scripts/` 下的测试套件。

# dsh-shake

[简体中文](README.zh.md)

A plugin for manually reducing context usage in **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. It replaces old tool output and large code and XML blocks in assistant replies with short placeholders. When needed, the model can retrieve the original text through `shake_read`.

> **Third-party plugin notice:** dsh-shake is an independently maintained third-party plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), not an official DeepSeek product. References to DeepSeek Harness indicate compatibility only and do not imply recognition, sponsorship, or endorsement by DeepSeek.

**No model-generated summaries. No deletion of original logs.** `/shake` only schedules cleanup; the actual replacements happen before the model request in the next normal conversation turn.

[Installation](#installation) · [Usage](#usage) · [Cleanup Scope](#cleanup-scope) · [Configuration](#configuration) · [Reading the Original Text](#reading-the-original-text) · [Limitations and Recovery](#limitations-and-recovery)

## Installation

### Requirements

| Component | Declared support range | Verified baseline |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness (`@deepseek-ai/dsh` and the corresponding `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` host services) | `0.2.0-rc.2` | `0.2.0-rc.2` |
| The Cordis fork used by DSH (`@deepseek-ai/cordis`) | `~4.0.4` (`>=4.0.4 <4.1.0`) | `4.0.4` |

The supported host service versions are defined by `peerDependencies` in [package.json](package.json). Cordis refers to `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, not the unscoped `cordis` package. Compatibility outside the ranges above is not guaranteed.

- **Node.js:** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.
- **Environment:** An initialized DSH Web profile.

Install `dsh-shake@latest` from npm.

### Install into a Web Profile

Check the DSH version, then install `dsh-shake@latest` from npm:

```sh
dsh --version
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-shake@latest --ignore-scripts
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Confirm that the configuration output includes `dsh-shake`. If DSH is already running, stop it first, then start Web:

```sh
dsh web
```

Installing the prebuilt package does not require linking source code or running build scripts. The default configuration is ready to use.

## Usage

1. Wait until the current session is idle, then send the following in the Web message input:

   ```text
   /shake
   ```

2. Once you receive the confirmation “Scheduled; will run before the next model request,” the cleanup request has been saved. **This does not call the model or immediately reduce the context.**
3. Send your next normal message. The plugin replaces eligible older text before DSH sends the model request.

If execution has not started, you can cancel:

```text
/shake cancel
```

Cancellation applies only to pending requests. **It cannot undo completed replacements.**

| Situation | Meaning and action |
| --- | --- |
| “No cleanup needed” message | There is currently no eligible text that would save tokens. No further action is needed. |
| The session is busy or under maintenance | Wait until the session is idle and retry. The command neither interrupts existing work nor queues itself. |
| A request is already pending | Each session can have at most one pending request. Repeating `/shake` does not reselect content. Cancel first if you want to schedule a new selection. |
| Attachments or other arguments are included | Only `/shake` and `/shake cancel` are supported; neither accepts attachments. |

## Cleanup Scope

By default, the plugin counts backward from the newest history and protects approximately the most recent **4,000 tokens**. Any message that crosses this boundary is also kept in full. Only earlier history is searched for the following content:

| Content | Default eligibility criteria |
| --- | --- |
| Successful tool results | The combined text within a single result must contain at least 1,000 tokens. Only text is replaced; non-text content such as images and the original metadata are preserved. |
| Plain-text assistant replies | A single complete fenced code block or XML block must contain at least 400 tokens. Text outside the block and its order are preserved. |

Placeholders also have a cost, so content is skipped if replacing it would not produce a net saving. Eligibility is checked again during execution; fragments that have already been replaced by another operation or are no longer suitable for cleanup are also skipped.

**The following content is never cleaned up:**

- User, system, and developer messages.
- Error tool results, `shake_read` results, and this plugin's control records, history excerpts, and content carrying those origins.
- Assistant messages containing images, thinking, tool calls, or other non-text blocks—the entire message is skipped.
- Ordinary long paragraphs in assistant replies, tool call arguments, and unclosed code fences or XML structures.

**Note:** Skill and plan text returned by ordinary read tools receives no extra protection and may still be cleaned up as tool results. The mandatory protections above cannot be disabled through configuration.

## Configuration

Keep the defaults unless you need to change them. To adjust settings, add a configuration override to the target profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. **Do not insert a second plugin instance.**

The default configuration is shown below:

```yaml
- id: dsh-shake
  config:
    protectedTokens: 4000
    toolTextMinTokens: 1000
    assistantBlockMinTokens: 400
    readDefaultLimit: 2048
    readMaxLimit: 4096
```

| Parameter | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `protectedTokens` | `4000` | The amount of recent history to protect, counted using locally estimated tokens, with whole messages preserved. |
| `toolTextMinTokens` | `1000` | A tool result is considered for cleanup only when its total text reaches this threshold. |
| `assistantBlockMinTokens` | `400` | An individual code or XML block in an assistant reply is considered for cleanup only when it reaches this threshold. |
| `readDefaultLimit` | `2048` | The page size for `shake_read` when `limit` is omitted, measured in Unicode code points. |
| `readMaxLimit` | `4096` | The maximum page size allowed by `shake_read`, in the same units. |

The first three values must be non-negative safe integers. Pagination settings must be integers satisfying `1 ≤ readDefaultLimit ≤ readMaxLimit ≤ 4096`. No other configuration fields are accepted.

Restart DSH after making changes. Requests that have already been scheduled retain the configuration and candidate fragments saved when they were scheduled.

## Reading the Original Text

Replaced text leaves a placeholder containing a `ref`. The model can call the **`shake_read` tool** to retrieve that fragment; it is not a slash command for users to enter.

Example arguments (replace the sample `ref` value with the full reference from the placeholder):

```json
{
  "ref": "<copy the full ref from the placeholder>",
  "offset": 0,
  "limit": 2048
}
```

The response contains the current page's `text`, the current `offset`, the fragment's `totalLength`, the next page's `nextOffset`, and the completion flag `done`.

- For the next page, use the same `ref` and set `offset` to the previously returned `nextOffset`.
- `done: true` and `nextOffset: null` indicate that reading is complete.
- Offsets and lengths are counted in **Unicode code points**, not bytes or the UTF-16 length of a JavaScript string.
- `offset` must be a non-negative safe integer and cannot exceed the fragment's total length. An empty page is allowed when the offset is exactly at the end. `limit` must be a positive integer no greater than the configured `readMaxLimit`.

A reference is a locator, not permission to read. The tool verifies the original text, actual replacement records, and checksums in the current session. **Only fragments that were actually removed can be read.** File paths and other session IDs are not accepted.

## Limitations and Recovery

### Before You Use It

- **This is not `/compact`.** It is manual text cleanup, not model-generated summarization. It does not provide the automatic, images, or thinking modes, or artifact files, of OMP's full shake implementation.

# dsh-plugin-workspace-archive

[DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DeepSeek Harness）插件：工作区文件夹被**删除或移走**时，把它名下的会话**归档**；同一个文件夹**放回来**时，把这些会话**带回**该工作区 —— 只走官方 API。

English: [README.en.md](README.en.md)

## 它补的是哪条缝

DSH 有意把"目录缺失"和"归档"分开：

- 目录无法校验的工作区（被移动、被删除、从未记录）**无法加入**新会话，其中的会话会散成「无项目」；
- 「移除项目」保留文件夹与会话历史，但**重新添加同一目录会从空项目开始**：旧会话不会自动回来。

本插件补上这条缺失的联动。它不改 `app.asar`、不写官方 `storages/` 与 `sessions/` 文件，自己的记账放在 DSH 主目录下的 sidecar 里。

## 它做什么

| 触发 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 已登记的工作区目录被删除或移走 | 把该路径下**由本插件登记过的**会话归档（侧栏默认视图不再显示，在"全部对话"里仍可见） |
| 工作区登记被移除（菜单里的「删除工作区」，文件夹还在） | 同样视为消失并归档 —— 否则那些对话会散成「无项目」。**这一条不等确认窗口**：官方删除登记是即时的，等窗口就是让你盯着那批对话散在侧栏里看几秒 |
| 目录或登记**回来** | 本插件归档过的那批会话**取消归档**；并且**台账里记过的全部成员**都会被挂回该路径的工作区 —— 包括**在消失之前就已经归档**的会话（典型是你自己手动归档的） |
| 一条会话待在「无项目」里，但它的工作目录**就是**某个已登记工作区的路径 | 启动后**自动挂回**该工作区（判据：不在任何工作区的成员表 + 目录**精确相等**；可用 `adoptUngrouped: false` 关闭） |
| **你说「归档这个工作区」**（模型调用 `workspace_archive` 工具） | 该工作区里**官方尚未归档**的会话被收进归档；`action='unarchive'` 恢复 —— **只放回本工具归档的那批**，你自己在官方界面里归档的原样不动。（注意：归档**不等于**隐藏工作区行 —— 官方默认每个分组都显示，行还在，只是下面空了） |
| **你在输入框打** `/archive-workspace <路径或标题>`（或 `/restore-workspace <…>`） | 和上一行**同一个动作**，但**由你自己触发、不经过大模型**。命令注册在宿主侧（官方 `dsh-commands`），输入框的命令弹窗里能选；恢复用的还是那批独立清单 —— 所以它**不会**放回你自己在官方界面里归档的会话 |

三条永不违反的规则：

- **你自己归档的会话永远不会被取消归档**：它们只是回到自己的分组里，仍然隐藏，直到你手动取消归档；
- **归档 / 恢复只处理它记过账的会话**：台账是插件运行期间、工作区健康时写下的；这条路径**绝不**按工作目录反查。唯一的例外是启动后那一次**归位**：只把**工作目录精确等于**某已登记工作区路径、且不属于任何工作区的会话挂回去，可用 `adoptUngrouped: false` 关闭。
- **手动归档与自动归档是两份清单，互不撤销**：你让它归档的工作区，不会因为那个目录"消失又回来"被自动流程放出来；反过来，自动归档的那批手动恢复也碰不到。

## 它为什么做得成（关键机制）

因为这条能力**不需要改任何文件**：DSH 里"会话属于哪个组"存在**工作区记录的一份成员表**里，而官方恰好提供了往这份表里补一笔的 API（`Workspace.attachSession`）。

1. **分组是"名册"，不是"档案"里的字段。** 会话日志里写的是它自己的工作目录；"它显示在哪个工作区下"是工作区记录里的成员表 —— 改分组 = 改名册，官方允许。
2. **官方挂载只校验一个条件，而这个条件天然成立。** `attachSession` 会读会话 header 的 `cwd`，要求它**规范化后精确等于**该工作区路径，否则拒绝；而"无项目"里的孤会话，cwd 本来就等于那个路径 —— 官方自己会放行（它也顺手代我们复核了一遍，塞错组在机制上不可能）。
3. **"没在名册上"是官方自己留下的空洞。** 官方只在**第一次启动**时按 cwd 把已有会话归组一次（bootstrap 一次性，写完 initialized 标记就不再跑），此后新增的工作区不会再回头认领旧会话 —— 这正是本插件补的那一步。

而"把会话从一个工作区迁到另一个工作区"**做不到**（在只走官方 API 的前提下）：那要求改 `cwd` 本身，可它是写死在会话日志里的，官方没有任何改 `cwd` 的 API。详见 [docs/recon/05-migration-and-multi-folder.md](docs/recon/05-migration-and-multi-folder.md) 与 [docs/plan-session-migration.md](docs/plan-session-migration.md)。

## 环境要求

- DSH（DeepSeek Harness）桌面版或 CLI；开发与验证基线是 `0.2.0-rc.2`。
- Node.js 22.5+（由宿主提供）。
- **零运行时依赖**：插件不 import 标准库以外的任何东西 —— 这是刻意的：通过目录联接装载的插件按真实路径解析嵌套 import，够不到宿主自带的包。

## 安装

三种方式，推荐第一种：

1. **从 npm 安装（推荐，2026-10-08 已发布 `0.1.0`）**

   ```
   dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-workspace-archive
   ```

   插件管理器走 npm registry（官方源，回退 `registry.npmmirror.com`；两侧实测都已同步）。想钉版本就写 `dsh-plugin-workspace-archive@<version>`。
2. **从本地检出安装**（本仓库真机验证用的就是这条）：把目录联接进 profile 的 `node_modules`，并把包名写进 profile 清单。本机用 `.verify/install-desktop.mjs` 一次完成这四步，`--uninstall` 可回滚。
3. **从本仓库按提交安装**：官方插件管理器也接受 GitHub 规格，例如 `dsh plugin add github:WindFromKadath/dsh-plugin-workspace-archive#<commit>`。

**必须重启宿主/应用**：插件行与 bundle 在启动时固定，HMR 从不热装载。配置默认值在 [src/index.js](src/index.js) 的 `resolveConfig`；profile 的 patch 行可以覆盖 `dryRun`、`confirmDelayMs`、`pollIntervalMs`、`watch`、`adoptUngrouped`、`adoptDelayMs`。

## 验证

- `npm test` —— **157 项**离线断言（工具行为、决策层、台账、真 Cordis 装载、"无项目归位"的选择逻辑、消失判据的分档确认、**目录 watcher 对「改名」事件的唤醒与不放大无关 churn**、**手动归档工作区的决策与工具定义契约**、**斜杠命令的注册与 handler 行为**、**`tasks.csv` 自身的结构守卫**，以及"插件源码不得 import 宿主包"的回归）。
- `npm run rm-test` —— **69 项**针对**真** DSH 运行时（一次性 `DSH_HOME`）的断言：建工作区 → 建两个真会话 → 删目录 → 断言只归档该归档的那个 → 放回目录 → 断言它被恢复并挂回工作区，而"用户手动归档"的那个**保持归档** → 删除登记再重新添加 → 断言都回到分组 → 未分组的孤会话被自动归位 → **命令阶段**：真 `dsh-commands` 里 `/archive-workspace`、`/restore-workspace` 确实注册成功且真能归档/恢复（含 3 条对照，证明"查询路径 / 定义形状 / inject 接线"各自可用）→ **改名阶段**：改文件夹名后插件被叫醒并在同一窗口内归档。
- `npm run check` —— 语法。

> 上面两套数字是**本仓库整套测试套件**的总数。仓库里另有一条**探索分支**（不随本包发布），它的测试也计入其中；见 [docs/plan-session-migration.md](docs/plan-session-migration.md)。

两套都可在本仓库一键重跑，且**不碰真实 profile、不碰真实工作区目录**。设计约束、已采纳决策与证据线索见 [MAINTAINER.md](MAINTAINER.md)。

## 已知限制

- **「删除工作区」立即归档，「目录缺失」要等几秒**，这不是不一致：目录缺失是一次 `stat` 的观测，可能抖（网络盘、改名中途），所以要等确认窗口（默认 3 秒）；而「删除工作区」是官方注册表的权威变更，且**本次运行中见过这条登记**，所以立即动手。插件刚启动、注册表还没铺完时不会走这条快路（那时"不在清单里"和"被删了"分不清），会退回确认窗口。
- **归档 / 恢复只认它记过账的会话**：若"删除 → 重新添加"发生在插件没运行的时候，它只认得台账里最后一次快照 —— 快照里有的成员会被挂回，更早散掉的不会（这类可以由启动时的**归位**补上，前提是 cwd 仍等于该工作区路径）。
- **挂回分组 ≠ 取消归档**：`attach` 只动工作区成员表，从不碰归档集合。
- **归位只跑一次**（启动后延迟 5 秒）：之后新出现的孤会话要等下次重启。
- **跨工作区迁移做不到**：需要在离线改写会话日志的 header，官方没有这个通道；而且即使改写成功，官方也**没有公开入口**去重建它在内存里缓存的会话 header ⇒ 必须重启 DSH 才生效。⇒ 这是一条**上游能力缺口**，本插件**不提供**该功能。完整的探索记录（机制、实测证据、为什么做不到）见 [docs/plan-session-migration.md](docs/plan-session-migration.md) —— 该目录**不随 npm 包发布**。
- 不做会话删除、不删文件夹、不做跨机器同步。
- 目录被**改名**等于换了一个路径：挂回时官方会校验 cwd，对不上时插件只记日志、不改数据。

## 更新记录

每个已发布版本的内容见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。当前版本 `0.2.0`。

## 许可证

MIT —— 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-hs-classify — Commodity classification register hierarchy consistency check

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-hs-classify?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-hs-classify?ref=badge)

`dsh-hs-classify` reads one classification register — the declarant header plus one row per item — and checks the structure of the numbers it records: that a commodity code is ten digits, that its chapter, heading and subheading are successive prefixes of the code, that the levels get progressively finer, that each row records a classification basis, that the header declares the tariff version the codes belong to, that item numbers are unique within the register, and that no unreplaced placeholder survives in the item name.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-hs-classify
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-hs-classify'
```

## What it looks like

![Workflow diagram for dsh-hs-classify: call → plugin → result.](docs/assets/dsh-hs-classify-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: call → plugin → result. The examples below use the real command surface.*



## What it answers

### Examples

The table below is the example set: the first row is the detailed walkthrough, the remaining rows are short cases.

#### Detailed output

**Tool** `hs_classify`

**Input**

~~~json
{"rows":[{"品名":"便携式自动数据处理设备","子目":"847140","商品编号":"8471300000"}]}
~~~
 
**Output**

~~~json
{
  "id": "dsh-hs-classify.HC-002.de09b5a6",
  "ruleId": "HC-002",
  "severity": "warn",
  "locator": {
    "field": "subheading",
    "row": 1
  },
  "found": "第 1 行「subheading」为「847140」，不是「hsCode」（8471300000）的前缀",
  "expected": "「subheading」应与「hsCode」的前几位一致",
  "fix": "核对层级填写；本条只核对前缀关系，不判断归类是否正确"
}
~~~

*Observed from `tests/fixtures/HC-002/HC-002-unsafe.json (cases.json expects HC-002 count 1); run via lib/index.mjs rules/hs-classify.yaml`*

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| Some codes in our register are eight digits, and one ends with a letter. Will the check report them? | Yes. `HC-001` matches every filled `hsCode` against the pack's `pattern`, `^[0-9]{10}$`, and reports the row together with the value it read. It checks the digit count and the characters only, never whether the goods belong under that code. A blank code cell is passed over, so what it reports is a code of the wrong shape, not a code that is missing. The ten digits are a pack setting: when the annual tariff changes the length, edit the `pattern`, not the code. |
| A row's 章, 品目 and 子目 do not agree with its 商品编号. Is that caught? | Yes. `HC-002` reads the level columns in coarse-to-fine order — 章, 品目, 子目, two, four and six digits in the pack's own example — and reports the level that is not a prefix of the `hsCode` it read, or that is not finer than the level above it. It checks that prefix relation and that order only: whether the code fits the goods is a customs determination needing the tariff and the classification decisions, which this plugin does not consult. A level cell left blank is not compared. |
| One row leaves 归类依据 blank. | `HC-003` reports that row: `basis` has to be filled in on every row that carries the column. It checks that something is written there, not that the tariff clause, chapter note, classification decision or advance ruling cited exists or supports the classification — this plugin consults none of them. If the register has no `basis` column at all, `HC-003` is listed in `skipped` with the reason that the material has no such column, instead of passing silently. |
| The header does not say which tariff version the codes belong to. | `HC-004` requires the header to declare `tariffVersion` and reports the register when the header leaves it empty. It checks that the declaration is present, not that the edition named is the one these codes come from: the rule does not read the codes, and codes are split and merged between editions. Its `fields` list is a pack setting — add `declarant` if your header records one. |
| 项号 5 appears on two rows. | `HC-005` reports the later row as a duplicate of the earlier one, because `itemNo` has to be unique within one register; whitespace is ignored in the comparison, so `5` and ` 5 ` count as the same item number. It checks uniqueness only. One goods item declared on several rows, for different specifications say, needs a different item number on each row. Item numbers that are all distinct still leave `HC-005` in `skipped`: it is then listed with the reason that the material met the check's preconditions and no differing entries were found — a different reason from the one a rule gives when it could not run because the column is absent. |
| The 品名 column still holds 【】 or 待填 from the template. | `HC-006` reports the row and the placeholder it matched. The pack looks for 【, 】, {{, }}, XXX, xxx, 待填, 待补充, TBD, todo and 示例, and `terms` can be trimmed to your own template. It finds unreplaced placeholders only: it does not judge whether the name is right, and it does not require the column to be filled — a blank `description` cell draws no finding from it, and no other rule in this pack requires one. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《中华人民共和国进出口税则》 | 现行版本本次未核实 | HC-001, HC-004, HC-005, HC-006 |
| 《商品名称及编码协调制度》 | 现行版本本次未核实 | HC-002 |
| 《中华人民共和国进出口关税条例》 | 国务院令第392号（2003年11月23日公布；根据2011年1月8日、2013年12月7日、2016年2月6日三次《国务院关于修改（废止）部分行政法规的决定》修订） | HC-003 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **商品归类台账** for the *structure* of the numbers it records — that a
commodity code is ten digits, that its chapter, heading and subheading are successive prefixes of it, that the
levels get progressively finer, that a classification basis is recorded, that the tariff version is declared,
that item numbers are unique, and that no placeholder survives. It does **not** decide which code goods should
be classified under.

> ### ⚠️ It checks the shape of a code, never whether the code is right
>
> **Classification is a customs determination**, turning on the goods' material, function and degree of
> processing together with the tariff's section and chapter notes and any classification decisions or advance
> rulings. **This plugin does not consult the tariff, does not consult classification decisions, and does not
> consult rulings.** So:
>
> - it **can** find "this row's code disagrees with the chapter, heading and subheading the same row states";
> - it **cannot** find "this row's code does not match the goods", because that needs the tariff itself.
>
> A register with a structurally perfect code for the wrong goods passes this plugin. That is the documented
> limit, stated in the header, in `HC-002`'s note, and in the troubleshooting section.
>
> **The rule pack states its citation status rule by rule.** **1 of its 6 rules quote verbatim clause text** and are marked `direct`; the remaining 5 state in the `excerpt` field itself that the text was not obtained, and stay at `warn` or `info`. Where a rule still carries that note, treat it as a lead rather than as a citation. The
> regime lives in 《中华人民共和国进出口税则》— whose codes are ten digits, the first six being the WCO
> Harmonized System — and 《中华人民共和国进出口关税条例》. For the rules whose text the verification pass could not retrieve, the pack states the gap in the
> `excerpt` field itself rather than paraphrasing it, and those rules stay at `warn` or `info`. **When the texts are in hand, replace each `excerpt` with the real clause and raise `kind`
> to `direct`.** The ten-digit assumption is a `pattern` in the rule pack, so an annual tariff change needs a
> rule-pack edit, not a code change.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. `engines.dsh` is declared as `>=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0` and is enforced by the host since 0.2.1 |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
|

# dsh-flash-ctx-mon

> The **context monitor** companion plugin for the core
> [`dsh-flash`](https://github.com/tcgbp/dsh-flash) package — it registers its own alert
> provider and its own panel switch instead of living inside the core's `apply()`.

Apache-2.0

**[中文](./README.zh-CN.md)**

## What it does

Two capabilities, one in each half of the plugin:

1. **Context monitor** — reads the **precise** token usage DSH already reports on its
   session event stream and turns pressure on the model's context window into
   `dsh-flash` alerts, at three rising thresholds.
2. **Session skills chip** — a chip beside the conversation tabs listing the skills the
   current session has actually loaded, resolved against the skill catalog.

The monitor is **on by default** — only an explicit "off" turns it off — and it is
**entirely client-side**.

## What it registers

### Host half — `src/index.ts` → `dist/index.js`

A Cordis plugin named `dsh-flash-ctx-mon`.

| Thing | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Settings namespace | `dsh-flash-ctx-mon` |
| Fields | `ctxApproxWindow`, `ctxThresholdInfo`, `ctxThresholdWarning`, `ctxThresholdError`, `ctxPollBase`, `ctxPollMin`, `modelContextWindows`, `modelContextWindowSources` |
| Routes | **none** |
| Host-side services | **none** (`inject: []`) |

**The host half exists only to hold the settings namespace and its schema.** There is no
collector and no route, because there is nothing to collect on the host: token usage
arrives through DSH session events (`ctx.get('sessions')`), the model catalog through
`remote.session.modelCatalog()`, and the skill catalog through `remote.skills.list()` —
all of it in the browser.

### Browser half — `src-client/` → `lib/client.js` (esbuild bundle)

| Registration | Through |
| --- | --- |
| Alert provider `dsh-flash-ctx-mon:context-alert` | `ctx.get('dockFlashAlerts').registerProvider()` |
| Panel switch `dsh-flash-ctx-mon:monitor-context` | `ctx.get('quickControl').registerSwitch()` |
| Session skills chip `dsh-flash-ctx-mon-skills` | `ctx.inject(['slots'])` → `conversation.session.header.actions`, rendered onto the session's tab strip |

Switch properties: `type: 'toggle'`, `group: 'system'`, `cluster: 'system-alerts'`,
`order: 59`, `icon: 'message'`, plus a **Configure** button. Its visibility follows
`dsh-flash`'s `dock-flash:system-alerts` master toggle — with the alert registry switched
off there is nothing for this switch to drive. It deliberately carries **no `subtitle`**:
the live "model · 12%" readout it used to print on the row is already the first thing in
the panel the Configure button opens.

> **Dual discovery, plus a fallback poll.** `ctx.get('quickControl')` /
> `ctx.get('dockFlashAlerts')` resolve asynchronously, so registration has three routes:
> the `dock-flash:ready` event (`dsh-flash` loaded after us), a synchronous `ctx.get()`
> check (it loaded before us), and a fallback poll of up to 15 attempts 200 ms apart.
> The first to succeed sets `_registered`, so nothing registers twice.

## The switch

In `dsh-flash`'s quick panel, under **⚙️ System → System Alerts**, find **Context
Monitor**:

- turning it **off** writes `'0'` to `localStorage['dsh-flash-ctx-mon:monitor-context']`
  and calls `setProviderEnabled(…, false)` on the alert registry, so the provider stops
  producing alerts;
- turning it **on** restores both.

**Who wins.** The browser key is the authority, and **absence means on**
(`getItem(key) !== '0'`). The host's own fields are all `volatile()`, so DSH resets them
to their defaults on every restart — the browser is what remembers your choice.

## The config modal

**Configure** beside the switch opens the context monitor panel:

| Control | Range | Step | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Context Window Size `ctxApproxWindow` | 64000–512000 tokens | 8000 | 128000 |
| Info Threshold `ctxThresholdInfo` | 30–80 % | 1 | 70 |
| Warning Threshold `ctxThresholdWarning` | 50–92 % | 1 | 85 |
| Error Threshold `ctxThresholdError` | 70–98 % | 1 | 95 |
| Context Poll Base Interval `ctxPollBase` | 5000–60000 ms | 1000 | 20000 |
| Context Poll Min Interval `ctxPollMin` | 1000–10000 ms | 500 | 2000 |

Below the sliders the panel reports the live state — **Current Model**, **Window Size**,
**Window Source** (Session Event / Model Catalog / Error Parsed / Manual / Built-in /
Fuzzy Match / Fallback), **Data Source** (Precise / Awaiting data), **Input Tokens** and
**Context Pressure** — and carries the **Model Window Map** editor, a **Refresh
Catalog** action, and a preview of what the alert messages look like.

## Alerts

Emitted only when the token source is `precise`; with no session-event usage data the
monitor reports "Awaiting data" and **emits nothing** — it does not guess from message
counts.

| Level | At | Title |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ℹ️ info | ≥ `ctxThresholdInfo` (70 %) | Session context getting long |
| 🟡 warning | ≥ `ctxThresholdWarning` (85 %) | Session context nearly exhausted |
| 🔴 error | ≥ `ctxThresholdError` (95 %) | Session context almost exhausted |

Each message carries the percentage and the reading it came from — `model ·
12.4K/128K` in precise mode. Alerts are `dismissible` and flow through `dsh-flash`'s
registry, so they appear in the panel's alert list and as toasts like any other.

## How a model's window is resolved

`_resolveWindow(model)` reads `modelContextWindows` — the **user-mapped** table in the
settings namespace — and labels each answer with its provenance from
`modelContextWindowSources`. A model that is not in the map resolves to `null`, and the
caller falls back to `ctxApproxWindow` (the "Fallback" source).

**The built-in window table has been retired.** `_KNOWN_WINDOWS` is empty and the
catalog auto-fill is a documented no-op, so today the map is the only source of a real
window size — which is why the panel's Model Window Map editor is how you teach it about
a model it gets wrong.

> Both map fields are `volatile()`, and that is **not** a statement that they are
> transient. The settings service rejects any patched path that is not under a volatile
> node (`Config field "…" is not volatile`), so a non-volatile `modelContextWindows`
> meant every mapping the panel wrote was rejected, rolled back and lost — a mapped
> model kept falling back to `ctxApproxWindow`. Volatile is what makes the write legal;
> the value still lands in the profile patch and survives a restart.

## Polling

The monitor samples on an adaptive interval: `ctxPollBase` is the **ceiling** used while
usage is low, and the interval tightens as usage rises, never below `ctxPollMin`. In
precise mode the base interval is doubled automatically, because the event source pushes
updates rather than being polled. A skill being used forces an immediate poll, so its
notice is claimed while the use is still fresh.

## The skills chip

The chip is drawn on the session's **tab strip**, directly after the last conversation tab.
DSH puts no session id on that strip — `data-conversation-session` marks the conversation
body only — so the header chip is what keeps it per-session: it stays registered into
`conversation.session.header.actions` as `dsh-flash-ctx-mon-skills` (order 15), renders a
hidden anchor carrying the id the slot handed it, walks up from that anchor to the nearest
ancestor holding exactly one strip, and mounts the visible chip there. An ancestor holding
more than one strip means another session is involved, so the chip stays in the header; a
session with a single conversation view has no strip at all, and the header chip remains
where it always was. A `MutationObserver` re-places the chip when a strip is rebuilt or
another tab appears.

It lists the skills **the current session** has loaded — subagents and other sessions are
excluded, because the slot hands the component the id of the session it renders for.

Detection uses DSH's own marker: the `<skill_content name="X">` block emitted when a
skill body is loaded. It arrives on two paths — the model calling the `skill` tool, and a
user typing `/name` in the composer (which produces **no** tool call of its own) — and a
failed call carries no block, so failures are not counted. Names are resolved

# dsh-flash-mem-mon

Memory monitor provider for [dsh-flash](https://github.com/tcgbp/dsh-flash) — registers a host-memory-alert provider (RSS absolute thresholds, RSS growth rate, Major GC frequency) via `ctx.get('dockFlashAlerts')` and exposes `/memory-trend` for trend sparklines.

## Installation

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-flash-mem-mon
```

Requires `dsh-flash >=1.0.0` (provides `dockFlashAlerts` and `quickControl` services).

## Configuration

All settings are live-editable (volatile) and take effect immediately:

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `memThresholdInfo` | 256 MB | RSS info threshold |
| `memThresholdWarning` | 512 MB | RSS warning threshold |
| `memThresholdError` | 1024 MB | RSS error threshold |
| `memThresholdCritical` | 1536 MB | RSS critical threshold |
| `memPollBase` | 30000 ms | Base polling interval |
| `memPollMin` | 2000 ms | Minimum polling interval |
| `gcThresholdInfo` | 2 /min | Major GC info threshold |
| `gcThresholdWarning` | 5 /min | Major GC warning threshold |
| `gcThresholdError` | 10 /min | Major GC error threshold |
| `memGrowthAlertPerMin` | 1 MB/min | RSS growth-rate (linear-regression slope) alert threshold, applied with trend = up |

## Architecture

This is a **companion plugin** following the same two-half pattern as `dsh-flash-net-mon`:

- **Host half** (`src/index.ts` → tsc → `dist/index.js`): Memory trend ring buffer, GC observer, `/memory-trend` HTTP route
- **Client half** (`lib/client.js`): Alert provider, enable toggle, config modal with sparkline, i18n via DSH's `locale` service

## License

Apache-2.0

# dsh-tool-microsoft-365

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A read-only Microsoft 365 plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It uses the Microsoft Graph v1.0 REST API to let an agent inspect the signed-in user's profile, Outlook mail, calendar, OneDrive metadata, and Teams chat search results.

The plugin does not send mail, edit events, upload or download files, change Teams data, or call any Microsoft Graph mutation endpoint.

## Install

~~~sh
npm install @libai168/dsh-tool-microsoft-365
~~~

The package requires @deepseek-ai/cordis (^4.0.1) and @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools (^0.1.0-rc.6) as peer dependencies.

## Authentication and configuration

Provide a delegated Microsoft Graph OAuth access token through the host configuration. The token must be kept outside source control and is never returned by a tool.

~~~yaml
- name: '@libai168/dsh-tool-microsoft-365'
  config:
    accessToken: 'replace-with-a-short-lived-delegated-graph-token'
    # timeoutMs: 15000
~~~

See [examples/cordis.yml](examples/cordis.yml). The client accepts only the production https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0 endpoint. This prevents a Bearer token from being sent to an arbitrary configured host. OAuth acquisition and refresh belong in the host application.

Recommended delegated permissions are the smallest set needed by the tools you enable:

| Capability | Microsoft Graph delegated permission |
|---|---|
| ms_auth_test, ms_get_profile | User.Read |
| ms_search_messages | Mail.Read |
| ms_list_calendar_events, ms_list_calendar_view | Calendars.Read |
| ms_search_drive_items, ms_get_drive_item | Files.Read |
| ms_search_chat_messages | Chat.Read |

Microsoft Entra consent and Conditional Access policies can require administrator approval. A token with fewer permissions returns the Graph status and a sanitized error code.

## Tools

| Tool | Description | Access |
|---|---|---|
| ms_auth_test | Verify the delegated token through /me and return safe profile fields | read |
| ms_get_profile | Read the signed-in user's allowlisted profile fields | read |
| ms_search_messages | Search Outlook messages through POST /search/query | read |
| ms_list_calendar_events | List default or selected calendar events | read |
| ms_list_calendar_view | List recurring event instances in an ISO 8601 time window | read |
| ms_search_drive_items | Search OneDrive files and folders | read |
| ms_get_drive_item | Read one OneDrive item's safe metadata | read |
| ms_search_chat_messages | Search Teams chat messages through POST /search/query | read |

Search requests use Microsoft Graph's read-only Search API with message or chatMessage entity types. Calendar and OneDrive collections use the Graph @odata.nextLink mechanism internally.

## Pagination

Each list tool returns a short, process-local nextCursor when Graph has another page. Pass that value back as cursor to the same tool. The cursor is random and contains no Graph URL or skip token; it expires when the plugin process exits. The plugin checks that every stored cursor belongs to the fixed collection path for that tool.

Offset search tools return nextFrom and accept it as from. Both offset and page-size values are bounded to avoid accidentally requesting an unbounded result set.

## Security and data boundaries

- Only https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0 is accepted as baseUrl; arbitrary HTTP hosts and absolute cursor URLs are rejected before a request.
- Every request uses Authorization: Bearer; the token and raw request headers never appear in tool output.
- Graph error messages are not copied into model output. Errors contain HTTP status, a validated short Graph error code, and a truncated request ID when available.
- Profile names, UPN/mail addresses, organization fields, sender fields, subjects, locations, and URLs are length-limited. Outlook and Teams content is restricted to a 1000-character preview with HTML stripped for Teams.
- Drive results omit file content and preauthenticated download URLs. The plugin only returns selected metadata fields.
- Requests honor timeoutMs and the tool execution AbortSignal. HTTP 429 and server errors are rethrown so the host can apply its normal retry policy.

## Limitations

- The MVP supports a delegated token only; application-only credentials and OAuth flows are intentionally outside the plugin.
- Search pagination uses Microsoft Graph offset semantics and can be affected by changes in the mailbox or chat index between calls.
- Calendar and OneDrive cursors are process-local. Restarting the host requires starting a new first-page request.
- No send, write, delete, upload, download, subscription, or administrative tools are included.

## Development

~~~sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm run build
npm pack --dry-run
~~~

See [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md) for endpoint mapping and release checks.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)
